title: Contact, Hours & Directions
seo_description: Contact Quest Watersports at 1851 N 2871st Road, Ottawa, IL. Call 815.433.2200 for sales, service, rentals and directions near Heritage Harbor.
body_html:
Visit our showroom and service facility in Ottawa, Illinois, next to Heritage Harbor Ottawa marina, or send us a message below.

Quest Watersports

1851 N 2871st Road
Ottawa, IL 61350
  • Phone: 815.433.2200
  • Store and orders: orders@questwatersports.com
  • Paddlesports and Hobie: hobie@questwatersports.com
  • Facebook: facebook.com/QuestWS

Hours

  • Sales: Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Sunday and Monday by appointment only.
  • Service: Tuesday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
  • Heritage Harbor Marina rentals: Saturday and Sunday, weather permitting. Call 815.433.2200.

Hours are the same in all seasons.

Directions

Our showroom and service facility is on N 2871st Road in Ottawa, about one mile from Heritage Harbor Ottawa. Get directions in Google Maps. Some mapping tools do not locate our mailing address (1851 Old Chicago Road, Ottawa, IL 61350) properly, so use the link above if your GPS gets confused.

Quest Watersports at Heritage Harbor Marina

1982 N 2753rd Road, Ottawa, IL 61350. Get directions. Learn more at Heritage Harbor Ottawa.

Send us a message

Use the form below and we will get back to you. Looking for a job? See employment. Member boat reservations are on the member reservations page.
